title: Preserve Linux utilization interface rates across transient enumeration failures
outcome: A disappearing interface does not discard valid counters or rate baselines for interfaces that remain present; incomplete enumeration stays explicit and bounded.
acceptance: A deterministic disappearing-interface fixture preserves measurements and rate baselines for unaffected interfaces.
Incomplete or oversized interface enumeration remains explicit; no fake zero counters or silently complete truncated roster is reported.
Focused validation and the required independent review cover the final change.
